items.question: Did Danielle Adams play in the WNBA?
items.answer: Yes. The San Antonio Silver Stars drafted Danielle Adams 20th overall in 2011, and she made the All-Star team as a rookie. She played five seasons for San Antonio (2011 to 2015) and one for the Connecticut Sun (2017), averaging 10.5 points in 174 regular-season games.

items.question: Where did Danielle Adams play college basketball?
items.answer: Danielle Adams played two seasons at Jefferson College, then two at Texas A&M. She scored 30 points in the 2011 NCAA title game win over Notre Dame and was named the tournament's Most Outstanding Player.
